title.narrative: Contribute to the peaceful coexistence of youth during 2015 elections in Burundi

description.narrative:
The project aims to contribute to improving peaceful cohabitation within Burundian youths when running electoral process. The aims will be achieved through training on responsible citizenship and good electoral practices, sensitisation and advocacy for respect of Human Rights. On the one hand the project seeks to increase knowledge on electoral issues and promote consideration for Human Rights by youth, and on the other to increase Communities (youths) awareness on election violence reduction in the sub region.
Radio programs lead by youths, as well as peer conferences will be produced to educate other youths on peace and electoral issues. Experiences to be gained in this project on youth peaceful involvement in electoral process will be shared with youths from DRC and Rwanda to enhance relations and responsible citizenship.
CDJP Bujumbura will lead and coordinate the monitoring of electoral violence and produce a report accordingly.
